additional_info.subject: ID0483591-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / SD 170004285] DC Coils MG1–MG4 Self‑Test issue CRM:02681001611
additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel,
We rebooted the charger.
This error message was related to the group converting, but is mainly caused by a bug in the new firmware.
After a reboot this normally dissappears, which in this case it also did.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
